integrity: The proof uses exhaustive residue-class splitting and an exact recurrence; sixth-moment limit is derived from the recurrence. No independent external mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Counts ordered triples of distinct modular square values, not square-root triples. Earlier work determines square-set Fourier transforms and some support cardinalities; priority of the explicit threefold fiber formula is qualified. Finite checks corroborate, rather than establish, infinite formulas.
title: Exact ternary convolution of distinct dyadic square values and its sixth Fourier moment
